alerts.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 15 at 4:48PM MDT until August 15 at 7:45PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Logan County in northeastern Colorado...
Northeastern Weld County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 745 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 448 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen.

- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Westplains, Pawnee Pass, Logan Corners, Willard, North Sterling
Reservoir and Stoneham.

alerts.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 15 at 4:08PM MDT until August 15 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
alerts.description:
FFWBOU

The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Weld County in northeastern Colorado...

* Until 715 PM MDT.

* At 408 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 3 inches in 1
hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 1.5 inches are possible
in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, gulches,
roads, and poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Northeastern Weld County.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Spring Creek, Twomile Creek, Horsetail Creek, Cottonwood Creek,
Sidney Draw, George Creek and North Pawnee Creek.

alerts.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 15 at 3:16PM MDT until August 15 at 6:15PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Morgan County in northeastern Colorado...
Central Weld County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 615 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry creeks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 316 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms over northern Weld County, moving slowly east.
Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the
advisory area. Up to 1.5 inches of rain have fallen.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Keota, Briggsdale, Jackson Reservoir, New Raymer, Purcell,
Buckingham and Cornish.

alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued August 15 at 11:52AM MDT until August 15 at 10:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flash Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Portions of central and northeast Colorado, including the
following areas: the southern Front Range Foothills, Palmer Divide
area, I-25 corridor, and all of our eastern plains counties.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM MDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Additional thunderstorms and heavy rainfall this afternoon,
combined with the heavy rainfall from the past 3 days, will bring
a threat for flash flooding this afternoon and evening. Stronger
storms will be capable of producing 1 to 2 inches of rain in 30
minutes, with isolated areas receiving storm totals of 2 to 4
inches.
